boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Emo box office opens at doors on day of show
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Emo�s is a cashless venue inside. We accept all major credit cards including VISA, Mastercard, Amex, & Discover. Apple Pay and Google Pay are also accepted.

venues.parkingDetail: We highly encourage rideshare. Drop off is in front of the security screening lanes. If you do drive, please carefully review signage. Please park on the streets where able. Emos is not responsible if your vehicle is booted or towed. AutoZone, Club Carnaval, and Taco More lots are actively booting.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: At Emos, we strive to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to all. The main entrance to Emos is fully accessible. Please be advised that this is done on a first come, first serve basis and our accessible seating area can reach capacity early. All bathrooms within the venue are equipped with ADA accessible stalls. ADA parking is first come, first serve and is located in front of the venue main entrance near our security checkpoint. Anyone needing prescription medicine must present the pharmacy labeled container which states the prescription, dosage, and patient name to our medical staff at each entrance gate.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information on our venue policies and FAQ, please visit our website https://www.emosaustin.com/
generalInfo.childRule: All guests ages 3 and older need a ticket for entry. Please provide ear protection for children.
